subject: communications.records

entries.definition: One provider workspace that scopes every conversation, message, thread, and participant identity in this collaboration specialization.
A public, private, or shared workspace-scoped conversation whose provider identity includes platform, workspace, and conversation components.
A private workspace-scoped conversation among exact provider participant identities, without inferred CRM identity.
A reply sequence rooted in one exact message and readable only inside its exact conversation and bounded selection.
One private untrusted communication event whose identity, sender, time, and content remain scope-bound and fingerprinted.
A provider workspace actor identity that is not a CRM person or organization unless a separate exact resolution establishes that link.
The durable set of exact channel identities and explicitly resolved cross-context links, excluding message and thread content.
A provider-neutral governed policy bounding channel identity sweeps, selected participant reads, CRM resolution, and later exact directory writes.

limitations: This vocabulary specializes the effect-free Communications base and grants no provider route, write, approval, or execution authority.
Direct messages are modeled but unavailable in the first conversation-review workflow.
Provider-native names, IDs, and member lists remain observations rather than portable CRM identity authority.
